inputs.prompt:
<Video 1>
The source video. This reference defines the scene sequence, camera motion, timing, lighting, environment, and all character motion.

<Picture 1>
Reference image of a tiny elderly man character. This reference defines only the character's appearance, facial features, proportions, clothing, hairstyle, and colors.

[Video Description]

Scene 1 (00:00–00:02)
An overhead view of a gray kitten lying on its back in a plush rectangular pet bed on a hardwood floor. The kitten stretches, wiggles happily, and briefly opens its mouth while a smiling woman leans into frame from the right, watching the kitten. The camera remains fixed.

Scene 2 (00:02–00:04)
The kitten sits upright in the same pet bed while the woman continues peeking in from the right side with a playful expression. The kitten looks toward the camera with small natural head movements. The overhead camera remains static.

Scene 3 (00:04–00:06)
A side view near a bright window. The kitten lowers its head and sniffs a neat line of small treats arranged on the wooden floor. The camera is low and stationary with soft daylight illuminating the scene.

Scene 4 (00:06–00:09)
The kitten walks across a computer keyboard on a desk in front of a monitor. The tail remains raised while it steps naturally across the keys. The monitor, speakers, desk accessories, and lighting remain unchanged.

Scene 5 (00:09–00:12)
A hallway viewed from a low camera angle. The kitten runs toward the camera from the far end of the hallway as a woman follows behind. The kitten exits near the camera while the woman continues walking forward. The camera remains locked off.

[Editing Instructions]

Replace the kitten in every scene with the elderly man defined by <Picture 1>.

Maintain the exact timing, camera placement, scene transitions, lighting, framing, environments, and background objects from <Video 1>.

The elderly man should perform the same actions as the kitten in every scene:
- lying comfortably in the pet bed while stretching and wiggling,
- sitting upright inside the pet bed,
- crouching to inspect the row of treats,
- walking across the computer keyboard,
- running down the hallway toward the camera.

Scale the elderly man to approximately the same overall size as the kitten in each scene so that he naturally fits the pet bed, keyboard, hallway, and surrounding environment.

Preserve all interactions with the environment, including realistic weight on the pet bed cushion, foot placement on the keyboard, natural body balance while running, accurate contact shadows, and correct perspective.

Use <Picture 1> exclusively to determine the character's appearance. Keep facial identity, clothing, colors, hairstyle, and proportions consistent throughout every scene.

Style: highly photorealistic with seamless integration, physically accurate lighting, realistic fabric and skin textures, and natural motion matching the original performance.

[Constraints]

Do not modify the environments.
Do not alter camera angles or shot timing.
Do not change scene order or transitions.
Do not add or remove objects.
Do not introduce new actions beyond those already present in <Video 1>.
